# Agentic Field Notes

> Practical notes on building agentic AI systems that survive production, by Shubham Mishra (Engineering Manager at Jisr). Covers orchestration graphs, MongoDB data patterns, retrieval (RAG), evaluation, tracing with Langfuse, security and AI engineering fundamentals.

## Start here

- Home: https://codertcet111.github.io/agentic-ai-learning/
- The 20-step path to an agentic backend: https://codertcet111.github.io/agentic-ai-learning/agentic-development/
- About the author: https://codertcet111.github.io/agentic-ai-learning/about/

## Topics

- AI Engineer Essentials: LLM behaviour, embeddings, prompting vs RAG vs fine-tuning, MCP, inference, guardrails, agent memory, LLMOps, privacy
- Graph & Orchestration: LangGraph routing, checkpoints, multi-agent handoffs, human-in-the-loop
- Mongo for AI: chat, turn ledger, pending forms, usage metering, idempotency, vector metadata
- RAG & Knowledge: chunking, retrieval as a tool, freshness, access control, retrieval evaluation
- Eval & Observability, Langfuse Lab, Testing as an AI Dev, Security for AI, LLM Engineering, Prompts & Tools, Build Guides
